effect_description_eng:
[When Digivolving] Trash the top 3 digivolution cards of 1 of your opponent's Digimon with DP less than or equal to this Digimon's DP. Then, 1 of your opponent's Digimon with no digivolution cards can't attack until the end of their turn.
[All Turns] This Digimon gains all effects of cards with [Gammamon] in their names in this Digimon's digivolution cards.
inherited_effect_description_eng: [All Turns] This Digimon gains all effects of cards with [Gammamon] in their names in this Digimon's digivolution cards.
